explanation: Holmes first appeared in A Study in Scarlet in 1887, nearly a decade before Dracula. Conan Doyle, who knew Stoker, wrote to praise the vampire novel.

claims.text: Sherlock Holmes first appeared in A Study in Scarlet, published in 1887.
Bram Stoker's Dracula was first published in 1897.
Arthur Conan Doyle, who knew Bram Stoker, wrote to him praising Dracula.
